subject: Fix type of now parameter in rdbLoadObject() to use mstime_t instead of time_t (#3255)
reason: The change only widens the type of rdbLoadObject()'s 'now' parameter from time_t to mstime_t. On the 64-bit Linux platform the fuzzer runs on, time_t and mstime_t are both 64-bit signed integers, so the parent build's implicit conversion of the mstime() value loses nothing and the single use of the parameter (the hash-field expiry comparison at rdb.c:2250) evaluates identically on both builds; the other callers pass a constant 0. The fix changes behavior only on platforms with a 32-bit time_t, which cannot be exercised in this environment, so no scenario can reach a behavioral difference and n
